Yes — Mira has a confirmed egg allergy, noted as mild hives, confirmed by Riverdale Pediatrics. That's the one to flag to any new caregiver, along with what reaction to watch for and what to do if it happens.

A couple of things worth telling the caregiver along with it:

- What the reaction looked like (mild hives) so they know what's "typical" for her versus something that needs a call to the office.
- To double check ingredient labels on snacks, since egg shows up in unexpected places (baked goods, pasta, some sauces).

If she's ever had a more significant reaction or an EpiPen was discussed, that's worth confirming directly with Riverdale Pediatrics before handoff, since I only have what's logged here.
